description: Real, first-hand ABN Lookup (abr.business.gov.au) search results for 'Ticketalay', 'AB Entertainment' and 'PAC Theatre Entertainment', plus the ABN detail record for the family partnership that actually holds the ticketalay.com.au domain, extracted from the entity-reality and entity-reality-reaudit verification packs.
spec_note: REAL-EXTRACT: rows are verbatim/paraphrased results from live ABR/ABN Lookup search and detail pages captured during the 2026-08-23 audit (entity-reality.md, entity-reality-reaudit.md), showing Australian business identity and GST-registration status — not a synthetic mock of the ABN Lookup schema.

'Your search for AB Entertainment found 56 matches'; no result is exactly named 'AB Entertainment'. Closest active row: ABN 91 819 759 805, 'A&B ENTERTAINMENTS' (Business Name), VIC 3030.
ABN 71 435 377 179, business name 'AB Entertainment' (Historic), Cancelled 25 Aug 2016, VIC 3082 — unrelated defunct sole trader (Aluthwatta, Manoj Krishantha), no connection to Ticketalay.
'found 18 matches', all fuzzy (e.g. P.A.C. PTY. LTD., PEACH ENTERTAINMENT PTY LTD) — no exact match; the Indian operator has no visible Australian ABN registration under its own name.

No Australian ABN/business name is registered for 'Ticketalay', no exact 'AB Entertainment' ABN exists, and no 'PAC Theatre Entertainment' ABN exists — as of 2026-08-23 there is no registered Australian entity behind the proposed AU proof market.
